title: Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI) - Concentration
overview: A formal concentration within the Symbolic Systems bachelor’s major, distinct from the Computer Science AI track. The currently linked G4 requirements document is dated September 27, 2024; later approved nominations require Stanford login and were not accessed.

requirements.title: Unit minimum and host-core overlap
requirements.summary: Each course must carry at least three units; this is a minimum, not verified exact course credit. If the earlier concentration requirements overlap the core, add approved contingent electives to reach five courses beyond the core.

notes: First-offered date is unknown; neither the catalog year nor an update date establishes a launch.

No concentration-specific assessed outcomes, descriptions, prerequisites, public course sites or example syllabi were verified in this bounded pass. Course titles and identities are observed; unknown exact course credits remain null.
The public document view explicitly permits anyone with the link without signing in. HTTP refresh sees only its JavaScript shell, so document extraction is a separate rerunnable public-export parser.
Cross-list aliases in parentheses are not silently counted as additional courses. HAI Human Impact and Augmenting Human Capabilities lists are examples under open criteria, not exhaustive pools.
